candidates.name: Bakken East Pipeline / Ellendale Lateral
aka: Bakken East southern lateral Jamestown to Ellendale
candidates.sponsor: WBI Energy (MDU Resources), for Applied Digital's Ellendale data center plant
candidates.from: Jamestown area, North Dakota (Bakken East Pipeline)
candidates.to: Ellendale, Dickey County, North Dakota (Polaris Forge 1)

evidence.note: Industrial Info says Applied Digital is considering a 300 MW gas plant supplied by a southern-flowing Bakken East lateral from the Jamestown area to Ellendale, and that Ellendale is on the receiving end of a planned branch line.
Pipeline and Gas Journal says the Bakken East route runs from the Bakken to Mapleton and Ellendale for power generation and data center demand; construction to begin 2028.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Length unknown. Towns are about 65 miles apart (Inforum), which is a distance between towns, not a sourced pipe length. Parent Bakken East is P8096 (Watford City to Mapleton); the Ellendale branch has no row. Plant is considered, not committed.

seed_ledger.name: Polaris Forge 1 power station (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: NEW_LATERAL: planned southern Bakken East lateral from the Jamestown area to Ellendale to feed Applied Digital's considered 300 MW gas plant; WBI Energy; proposed, construction from 2028; length unknown (towns about 65 miles apart). Related to P8096 but a separate branch.

evidence.note: names lateral to Ellendale and the 300 MW plant
route to Mapleton and Ellendale for data center demand

seed_ledger.name: Polaris Forge 2 power station (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: NOT_FOUND: searched B&W and Applied Digital releases, trade press, North Dakota PSC results, local news. Harwood data center is reported as supplied by Cass County Electric (280 MW peak), with no gas pipe named. Minnkota's separate 400 MW Harmony Township plant near Mapleton is tied to Bakken East but no source links it to Applied Digital. P0367 at 1.5 km is unconfirmed. EIA, FERC, air permit and county records not found in searches.

evidence.note: Cass County Electric supplies Applied Digital Harwood; Minnkota plant depends on Bakken East

seed_ledger.name: River Run Energy Center (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: NOT_FOUND: 1,450 MW plant beside the Leland Olds substation, Mercer County, in design, MOU December 2025; county voted March 2026 to suspend data center development for a year. NextEra FAQ, Basin Electric releases and trade press name no pipeline or supplier. EIA, FERC, state air permit not found.

evidence.note: site next to Leland Olds substation; no pipeline named
